Check publication-gate shell syntax.

findings.title: Bind credential hand-review approvals to the reviewed content
findings.trigger: A previously approved file is updated with another 32-character lowercase hexadecimal value, then staged, while its existing credential hand-review entry remains.
findings.execution_path: The 32-hex scan returns only the filename. Line 65 calls reviewed() with the path and a constant disposition prefix, without a content hash or identity of the reviewed matches. The old entry succeeds regardless of the added value. Staging the update makes the final index/worktree comparison succeed too.
findings.consequence: A newly introduced Radarr/Sonarr-style API key can bypass the required fresh hand review when gitleaks does not recognize it. The contract explicitly identifies these prefixless keys as a gap requiring the supplemental scan. Mutable evidence Markdown and redacted reports are covered by this gate, so Codex-output immutability alone does not prevent the sequence.
findings.evidence: The isolated execution of the script's actual awk parser returned exit 0 for both a file with one previously reviewed synthetic hex value and a file with an additional synthetic hex value, using the same approval. The self-test covers stale hashes for public-infrastructure exceptions but has no corresponding stale-credential-approval case.
findings.suggested_fix: Bind credential exceptions to a digest of the reviewed content or reviewed match set, and require renewed review when it changes. Add a regression that approves a harmless hex value, adds a second value at the same path, stages it, and expects the gate to block.
findings.reproduction_command: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,os; s=Path(".planning/phases/86-pilot-reference-record/86-publication-gate.sh").read_text(); p=s.split("reviewed() { X=$1 S=$2 M=$3 awk ")[1].split(chr(39))[1]; e=dict(os.environ,X=".planning/phases/86-pilot-reference-record/vibe-check/example.md",S="Credential-shape hand review",M=": not a credential -- "); record="## Credential-shape hand review\n- `"+e["X"]+"`: not a credential -- fixture identifier reviewed previously\n"; print(subprocess.run(["awk",p],input=record,text=True,env=e).returncode)'
